name: realm
description: A local macOS application for authoring fictional world maps across historical time.

scripts.build:mac: tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles app && node scripts/build-macos-package.mjs
scripts.security:audit: pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high && cargo deny --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked check advisories
scripts.security:audit:strict: pnpm audit --prod --audit-level low && cargo deny --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked check advisories
scripts.verify: pnpm runtime:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm rust:fmt:check && pnpm rust:clippy && pnpm rust:test
scripts.verify:full: pnpm verify && pnpm docs:index:check && pnpm architecture:check && pnpm licenses:check && pnpm sbom:check && pnpm build:web
scripts.verify:local:push: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm verify:full && pnpm security:audit:strict && git -C .. diff --check && ../.githooks/secret-guard.sh --self-test
scripts.verify:local:release: pnpm verify:local:push && pnpm build:mac && pnpm package:check && pnpm smoke:package && pnpm release:assets
